findings.locator: cfg=json.loads(...helper-config.json...) immediately before resolved/open issue checks
findings.finding: Cleanup consumes current config issue dispositions without binding the config bytes to the successful commit/queue helper snapshot. A post-queue config edit could remove or change required issue states while all head/tree/receipt identity guards still pass.
findings.evidence: commit and queue bind config through helpers/current digests; cleanup only reads its resolved_review_issues and remaining_source_issues. No hash assertion for that config is present in the inspected cleanup source.
findings.suggested_correction: Before consuming current config, assert its SHA256 equals c["helpers"][str(config_path)] (and preferably the matching push receipt value already expected from queue).
findings.acceptance: Untouched bound config passes; a byte-changed config is rejected before any issue query or remote/local branch deletion; wrong/missing committed config digest fails closed.
